t: What the martyr asks for after seeing what it is worth
a: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَرُدَّنِي إِلَى الدُّنْيَا فَأُقْتَلَ فِي سَبِيلِكَ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ لِمَا يَرَى مِنْ فَضْلِ الشَّهَادَةِ
p: Asʾaluka an taruddanī ilā-d-dunyā fa-uqtala fī sabīlika ʿashra marrāt
m: I ask You to send me back to the world, so that I may be killed in Your path ten times over.
